name: App.VersionMajor
description: Software version - major (2 character ascii text)

name: App.VersionMinor
description: Software version - minor (2 character ascii text)

name: App.VersionRelease
description: Software version - release (2 character ascii text)

name: Input.T17
description: Preheater or earth tube air intake temperature

name: Alarm.Status
description: Alarm state bit mask 0x80 : Active alarm(s) present 0x03 : Nb. of alarms listed

name: Alarm.List_1_ID
description: Alarm 1 – Code 0x80 : (reserved future use) 0x7F : Display code 1..99

name: Alarm.List_1_Date
description: Alarm 1 – Date Bit word packed in DOS date format. Year 0 = 1980 15 8 7 0 HHHHHMMM MMMSSSSS

name: Alarm.List_1_Time
description: Alarm 1 – Time Bit word packed in DOS time format. Seconds are in scale 2 (0..29=0..58 seconds) 15 8 7 0 HHHHHMMM MMMSSSSS

name: Control.ModeAct
description: Actual operation mode 0 : Off 1 : Heat 2 : Cool 3 : Auto 4 : Service

name: Control.State
description: Actual control state 0 : Off 1 : Shift 2 : Stop 3 : Start 4 : Standby 5 : Ventilation stop 6 : Ventilation 7 : Heating 8 : Cooling 9 : Hot water 10 : Legionella 11 : Cooling + hot water 12 : Central heating 13 : Defrost 14 : Frost secure 15 : Service 16 : Alarm 17: Heating + hot water

name: AirFlow.VentSet
description: Actual ventilation step set point 0 : Off 1..4 : Step number

name: AirFlow.InletAct
description: Actual ventilation step set point 0 : Off 1..4 : Step number

name: AirFlow.ExhaustAct
description: Actual ventilation step set point 0 : Off 1..4 : Step number

name: AirFlow.SinceFiltDay
description: Days since last air filter change alarm One day is measured as 24 hours of active running time

name: AirFlow.ToFiltDay
description: Days to next air filter change alarm One day is measured as 24 hours of active running time

name: Output.PreHeatCap
description: Preheater capacity or earth tube air intake fan speed

name: Alarm.Reset
description: Clear one specific alarm code or all 0 : No command 1..99 : (reserved internal commands) 101..199 : Clear alarm display code 1..99 255 : Clear all alarms

name: Program.Select
description: Week program nb. select 0 : None 1 : Program 1 2 : Program 2 3 : Program 3 4 : Erase

name: Program.UserFuncSet
description: User function select 0 : None 1 : Extend 2 : Inlet 3 : Exhaust 4 : External heater offset 5 : Ventilate 6 : Cooker Hood

name: Program.UserVentSet
description: Step User function ventilation 0 : Off 1..4 : Step number

name: Control.RunSet
description: User on / off select (=ON/OFF keys) 0 : Off (user functions can still activate operation) 1 : On

name: Control.ModeSet
description: User operation mode select 0 : Off 1 : Heat (no cooling active) 2 : Cool (no heating active) 3 : Auto 4 : Service (read only – write to register 1005)

name: Control.VentSet
description: User ventilation step select 0 : Off 1..4 : Step number

name: Control.ServiceMode
description: Service mode select 0 : Off 1 : Defrost 2 : Flaps 3 : Inlet 4 : Exhaust 5 : Compressor 6 : Heating 7 : Hot water 8 : Central heat

name: Control.Preset
description: Request preset to factory settings 0 : Ready 1 : Standard (to factory default) 2 : Backup (to user file) 3 : Restore (from user file)

name: AirFlow.AirExchMode
description: Air exchange mode 0 : Energy 1 : Comfort 2 : Comfort Water

name: AirFlow.TestSelect
description: Select weekly air damper position self-test Once enabled, the function cannot be deactivated 0: Off 1: Wednesday 0400 2: Wednesday 1200

name: AirFlow.LastTestDay
description: Date of last air damper position test Bit word packed in DOS date format (see IR 402 format)

name: AirFlow.TestState
description: Actual air damper position test state 0: Off 1: Standby 2: Start(Set to Start to run manual test) 3: Closing 4: Opening 5: OK 6: Error

name: AirTemp.CoolSet
description: Cooling temperature setpoint select 0 : Off (No cooling allowed) 1 : Set + 0 °C (User setpoint plus 0 degrees) 2: Set + 1 °C 3: Set + 2 °C 4: Set + 3 °C 5: Set + 4 °C 6: Set + 5 °C 7: Set + 7 °C 8 : Set + 10 °C

name: AirTemp.NightDayLim
description: Outdoor day temperature for night cooling activation [0:Off, 20..40]

name: AirTemp.NightSet
description: Free energy night cooling room setpoint [10..30]

name: CentralHeat.HeatExtern
description: External heating offset from room temperature setpoint

name: AirQual.RH_TimeOut
description: Humidity max. time on high ventilation

name: Display.KeyCode
description: User panel keypress Repeated if not cleared within 400 ms Combined value with one bit for each key 0x01 : ESCAPE 0x02 : UP 0x04 : DOWN 0x08 : ENTER 0x10 : OFF 0x20 : ON
